attempted_claim: Let L=(Z/2Z) wr Z be the lamplighter group acting by Borel automorphisms on a standard Borel space X with no freeness assumption. Is the orbit countable Borel equivalence relation E^X_L hyperfinite, i.e. an increasing union of finite Borel subequivalence relations?
decisive_failure: The target could not be resolved because hyperfiniteness for arbitrary non-free Borel actions of the lamplighter group is an open subcase of Weiss's question: the strongest published lamplighter theorem covers only free actions and lifts freeness only for polycyclic groups. No independently original emergent finding or Audit-passing target-adjacent alternative was discovered; the retained computations verify only standard facts.
